Thanks for the quick follow-up, Priyom — and hi Vivek, Marissa. Happy to sync. A few clarifying points before we book the hands-on session: 

1) Auth model — we prefer a GitHub App (app installation) over OAuth where possible. Can you show how app-scoped permissions map to the features (annotations, repo webhooks, workflow permissions)?
2) Data flow — we want to understand what data is sent to Redwood hosted endpoints during scans (sha, file paths, findings). Are there options for on-prem connectors to keep artifacts inside our VPC?
3) RBAC — how do you recommend setting up least-privilege for installation across orgs, and can you demo per-repo vs. org-wide installs?

We prefer Wed, May 5 in the morning PST. 9:00am PST would work best. If you can share a pre-demo checklist or agenda that would be super helpful.

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan
Engineering Manager, SourceHook Inc.

Hi Samira — great to meet you over email, and thanks for the clear questions. 9:00am PST on Wed, May 5 works for us. I’ve created a calendar placeholder and attached a short demo agenda and pre-demo checklist so the session can be hands-on.

Agenda (30 min):
- 0–5m introductions & goals
- 5–15m walkthrough: GitHub App install flow & permissions mapping
- 15–25m live demo: repo scan -> findings -> annotation on PRs (we’ll use a small public test repo or your provided repo excerpt)
- 25–30m next steps: deployment options (hosted, VPC connector, on-prem package) and follow-ups

Pre-demo checklist (please try to provide if you can):
- A repo we can install/test on (public or a short-test private repo + install token)
- Example PR or commit to trigger a scan
- Any specific policy/rules you want to see applied

Attachments: demo-agenda-sourcehook.pdf (agenda + checklist)
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If anything comes up and you need to move the slot, let me know — otherwise I’ll send the invite and we’ll plan to use the first 5 minutes to confirm the test repo.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
